recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not remove Resource-valued OperationDefinition.resource entries for this issue; if FHIR-51651 is later applied, handle its broader URI/logical-model design as a separate R6 change.
issue_request: FHIR-40118 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction reporting that 5.0.0-snapshot3 Profiles-resources.xml contained Resource-level OperationDefinitions whose OperationDefinition.resource value was "Resource", while the then-used ResourceType binding did not include the abstract Resource code.
initial_application: Git commit a3f1bf01af25d350a34b9089ddbf94138f217429 applied the issue by changing OperationDefinition.resource from ValueSet/resource-types to ValueSet/all-resource-types and clarifying the resource type value set descriptions. That made Resource-valued operation definitions valid rather than changing each operation instance.
additional_context: The active current source includes Resource as an abstract resource in source/fhir.ini and the active Resource operations list now references Resource-validate, Resource-convert, and Resource-graphql. OperationDefinition.resource explicitly says abstract resources such as Resource and DomainResource can be used and now binds to version-independent-all-resource-types with all-resource-types as the R5-specific additional binding. FHIR-40492 later moved the element to the inter-version all-resource-types binding family while preserving the R5 additional binding. FHIR-51651 is a later R6 Resolved - change required proposal to make OperationDefinition.resource and related elements URI-capable for logical models, but it is not Applied/Published and does not change this R5 correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because the current authoritative binding and explanatory comment already allow the Resource values reported by the issue.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 issue that changed OperationDefinition.resource to use the inter-version resource type binding family and retained an R5 all-resource-types additional binding.
Later R6 Resolved - change required proposal for URI/logical-model support; not applied/published and outside this default reconciliation scope.
